items.question: What name and currency code are recorded for airline LH?
items.reference_sql: SELECT c~name, c~currency_code FROM /dmo/carrier AS c WHERE c~carrier_id = 'LH'

items.question: How many different countries have airports listed?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT a~country ) AS country_count FROM /dmo/airport AS a

items.question: Show the first 10 agencies alphabetically, with their names, agency numbers, phone numbers and email addresses. Break ties by agency number.
items.reference_sql: SELECT a~name, a~agency_id, a~phone_number, a~email_address FROM /dmo/agency AS a ORDER BY a~name ASCENDING, a~agency_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

items.question: How many routes depart from each airport? Show departure airport codes and route counts.
items.reference_sql: SELECT c~airport_from_id, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM /dmo/connection AS c GROUP BY c~airport_from_id

items.question: How many different customers have flight bookings?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT b~customer_id ) AS customer_count FROM /dmo/booking AS b

items.question: How many times has each extra been added to a booking? Show extra codes and counts.
items.reference_sql: SELECT s~supplement_id, COUNT(*) AS extra_count FROM /dmo/book_suppl AS s GROUP BY s~supplement_id

items.question: How many flights are scheduled on each date in November 2026? Show dates and flight counts, earliest date first.
items.reference_sql: SELECT f~flight_date, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM /dmo/flight AS f WHERE f~flight_date BETWEEN '20261101' AND '20261130' GROUP BY f~flight_date ORDER BY f~flight_date ASCENDING

items.question: Show the first 10 customers by customer number, with their customer numbers, first and last names, phone numbers and email addresses.
items.reference_sql: SELECT c~customer_id, c~first_name, c~last_name, c~phone_number, c~email_address FROM /dmo/customer AS c ORDER BY c~customer_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

items.question: Which 10 trips priced in euros have the lowest booking fees? Show trip numbers and booking fees, lowest fee first, then by trip number.
items.reference_sql: SELECT t~travel_id, t~booking_fee FROM /dmo/travel AS t WHERE t~currency_code = 'EUR' ORDER BY t~booking_fee ASCENDING, t~travel_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

items.question: Which routes connect Frankfurt (FRA) and New York (JFK), in either direction? Show airline codes, route numbers, and departure and arrival airport codes.
items.reference_sql: SELECT c~carrier_id, c~connection_id, c~airport_from_id, c~airport_to_id FROM /dmo/connection AS c WHERE ( c~airport_from_id = 'FRA' AND c~airport_to_id = 'JFK' ) OR ( c~airport_from_id = 'JFK' AND c~airport_to_id = 'FRA' )
